automation.notes: TopstepX API Access describes automated strategy support. The same help page says trading activity must originate from a personal device and VPS/VPN/remote servers are prohibited.

risk.notes: The $1,000 daily limit is the optional 50K DLL. The simulator and bot impose stricter self-limits; the core Combine rule is the $2,000 MLL.

consistency.notes: Use a conservative consistency cap until the exact account rule is confirmed.
